name: bias_battery_west_coast_early_kickoff_opener
hypothesis: Traveling Pacific-timezone team, non-PT opponent, kickoff before 14:00 ET -- subset cover rate vs. complement. Opener-grade re-screen of an already-recorded close-graded cell; mined family, uncorrected multiplicity; recorded for direction and pooling, not as a finding.

reliability_check.reason: west_coast_early_kickoff is a per-game situational condition (this game's own travel/kickoff time), not a persistent per-team trait -- there is nothing to split-half.
